'''Big Woolly''' was a township that was located in the northern reaches of a landmass on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], and the name of the settlement was a reference to a nearby [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] that was covered in [[Conifer/Legends|conifers]], giving it a fleece-like appearance. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and several members of the [[Whiplash]] resistance group traveled to Big Woolly, and Pavan and the [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] ventured out in the town to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Mossy Glen Inn]], to rendezvous with the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Aren Folee]].
